headline: Indonesia Adds Patchouli Oil to National Warehouse Receipt System
summary: Indonesia's Ministry of Trade officially added patchouli oil to its eligible warehouse receipt system list, allowing agricultural producers to access commodity collateral financing.
why: Indonesia supplies over 80% of global patchouli oil; incorporating it into warehouse receipts stabilizes essential oil export financing.

impacts.name: Indonesia
impacts.why: Warehouse receipt inclusion enhances supply chain liquidity and pricing power for Indonesian oil exporters.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
